nameEn: Manufacture of prepared meals and dishes
description: This class includes the manufacture of ready-to-eat meals and dishes that are packaged and sold for home consumption.
includes: manufacture of prepared meals and dishes: ready meals, pre-cooked meals, frozen meals
manufacture of chilled or frozen prepared foods
manufacture of dishes based on meat, fish, vegetables or other food
excludes: manufacture of fresh prepared food, see retail trade (47)
preparation of meals in food-service activities, see 56
